    ULiftHom supplies the common large Hom universe needed by the existing coend implementation. The additive and linear structures are the evident ones obtained by lifting the original Hom groups and modules.

        Type (max (max vK wC) wK)

        Hom-bifunctor retraction with independent source and target Hom universes. LinearMap itself needs no resizing: its domain and codomain may live in different universes.

        • retraction (X Y : K) : (D.obj X ⟶ D.obj Y) →ₗ[k] X ⟶ Y
        • map_retraction {X Y : K} (f : X ⟶ Y) : (self.retraction X Y) (D.map f) = f
        • naturality {X' X Y Y' : K} (a : X' ⟶ X) (g : D.obj X ⟶ D.obj Y) (b : Y ⟶ Y') : (self.retraction X' Y') (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (D.map a) (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp g (D.map b))) = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp a (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp ((self.retraction X Y) g) b)
